newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian share market active, index slips.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian share market active, index slips.

text.p: The Lithuanian stock exchange was active on Tuesday although brokers' in-house indices slipped, dealers said.
Central market volume came to 436,000 litas and the Suprema brokerage firm said its index, which traces shares representing 50 percent of market capitalisation, fell 5.87 percent to 1,069.
"Blue chips rose too fast lately. In the long-term they will continue to rise but not at the same pace," said one trader.
The central market has also been buoyed recently by a fall in T-bill yields, with investors switching from government paper to equities.
Market leader Vilnius Bank fell to 1,150 litas from 1,200 litas while one of the biggest dairy firms, Birzhu Dairy, slipped to 4.50 litas from 4.60.
